CPM-BULL-NDX Strategy Dashboard

60% CPM (canary-gated momentum + min-vol pair) + 30% BULL-QQQ (trend overlay) + 10% NDX (top-K Nasdaq-100 concentration).

Backtest window: 2007-02-28 to 2026-05-22 | Built: 2026-05-22

Strategy at a glance

Production blend: 60/30/10 CPM-BULL-NDX, monthly rebalance, T+1 OPEN (next-day MOO), 10 bps/side cost.

  • CPM (60%): 9-asset universe (US factor + intl + diversifier), HYG+TIP+GLD any-positive 13612U canary, Faber SMA10 ranker top-5, min-vol pair selection (504d cov), hold buffer 2.0z, vol cap 15% (de-risk only, no leverage). SHV cash fallback.
  • BULL-QQQ (30%): 100% QQQ when QQQ 12-1 absolute momentum > 0 AND HYG/LQD/TIP any-positive 13612U canary fires. Otherwise 100% SHV.
  • NDX (10%): Top-4 PIT Nasdaq-100 by 13612U momentum, equal-weight 25%, gated by BULL_QQQ regime. SHV when off.

Headline (19.2y, post-cost): 60/30/10 blend Sharpe 1.38, CAGR 17.85%, MaxDD -15.34%, Calmar 1.16, Martin 4.80.

Bootstrap 95% CI is wide; honest forward base-case 0.90-1.20 Sharpe / 10-14% CAGR after in-sample selection bias discount.

Canary Regime History

CPM canary (HYG/TIP/GLD any-positive 13612U): Risk-on 91.8% (213/232) -- pair selection runs. Defensive 8.2% (19/232) -- 100% SHV cash, fires only when HYG (credit) AND TIP (inflation) AND GLD (real-asset) are simultaneously negative. Why GLD belongs here: CPM is a cross-asset engine that holds gold as a tradable diversifier -- the canary should activate on the same real-asset / inflation / dollar-weakness regimes that make GLD or TLT the right pair. A GLD-positive month often is exactly the kind of risk-off-but-not-cash month where CPM should still rotate into defensive diversifiers rather than retreat to cash.

BULL canary (HYG/LQD/TIP any-positive 13612U + QQQ trend): QQQ on 82.8% (192/232), cash 17.2% (40/232). Why LQD belongs here (not GLD): BULL-QQQ is a single-asset Nasdaq overlay -- the canary should require evidence that equity risk-taking is healthy, which means credit markets bidding (HYG high-yield + LQD investment-grade) and real rates supportive (TIP). Gold-bid regimes are often equity-hostile flights to safety; a long-QQQ position should NOT be unlocked by GLD strength alone.

Mechanism summary: CPM's canary uses GLD because gold is part of its tradable diversifier set (a GLD-positive regime invites CPM to rotate INTO gold). BULL's canary uses LQD because investment-grade credit confirms broad risk-on across the credit stack -- exactly what an equity-only overlay needs before going long. HYG_stitched = VWEHX pre-2007-04 + live HYG.

Strategy Spec

CPM Sleeve (60%)
  • Universe (9): US factor + international + diversifier. Live-trade equivalents: IWF→SCHG (corr 0.994, 14bps cheaper), DBC→PDBC (no K-1).
    QQQ, IWF, VBR, SPHQ, EFA, EEM, GLD, TLT, DBC
  • Safe pool: SHV (ultra-short Treasury cash, ~0.3y duration)
  • Canary: HYG_stitched + TIP + GLD -- ANY positive 13612U momentum -> risk-on; all negative -> 100% SHV. HYG_stitched = VWEHX pre-2007-04 + live HYG.
  • Ranker: Faber 10-month SMA distance: (price - SMA10) / SMA10
  • Top-K candidates: top 5 by ranker (= ceil(9/2), top-half rule), drop negative momentum
  • Pair selection: minimum-variance 50/50 pair (504d covariance lookback, ~2.0y)
  • Hold buffer: 2.0 z-units (keep prior pair member unless new candidate exceeds by this margin in cross-sectional z-score)
  • Partial-safe fill: 1 positive momentum → 50% asset + 50% SHV; 0 positive → 100% SHV
  • Vol cap: 15% annualized target, 63d realized vol, max 1.0x (de-risk only, no leverage). Fires only in crisis regimes (~17% of days).
  • Cost: 10 bps/side
  • Execution: month-end signal (T = last trading day of month, close), T+1 OPEN trade (next trading day MOO)
BULL-QQQ Sleeve (30%) -- bull capture with cash defense
  • Bull asset: 100% QQQ (Nasdaq-100). No state-conditional rotation.
  • Trend filter: QQQ 12-1 absolute momentum > 0 (Antonacci GEM standard). Removed prior 13612U OR composite as data-mined to 2009/2023 V-bottom recoveries.
  • Macro gate: HYG OR LQD OR TIP positive 13612U (any-positive, 3-asset credit/inflation canary). Adds +54% Martin Ratio over mom-only at small CAGR cost.
  • Fallback: 100% SHV (short-treasury cash) when either filter fails. Zero duration risk on this sleeve.
  • Standalone (19.2y, post-cost): Sharpe 1.03, CAGR 17.97%, MaxDD -28.56%, Ulcer 7.59%, Martin 2.37.
NDX Sleeve (10%) -- concentrated Nasdaq-100 momentum
  • Universe: PIT Nasdaq-100 constituents (via index-constitution library, coverage 2006-01+).
  • Signal: 13612U momentum per stock (same formula as CPM canary, canonical HAA unweighted).
  • Selection: top 4 by momentum (positive only), equal-weighted 25% each.
  • Gate: only allocates when BULL-QQQ regime is BULL_QQQ (equity-friendly); cash otherwise.
  • Fallback: 100% SHV when gate off or fewer than 4 positive-momentum candidates.
  • Standalone (19.2y, post-cost): Sharpe 1.19, CAGR 39.47%, MaxDD -48.54%, Ulcer 19.56%, Martin 2.02.
  • Tradeoff: High beta, high vol, deep DD as standalone. Diluted by 10% blend weight contributes ~+0.07 Sharpe / +2.5pp CAGR at the portfolio level.

Honest Caveats

  • In-sample selection bias: hyperparameters and universe tuned on this same data window. Forward Sharpe should be anchored at 0.90-1.20 (not backtest 1.36) for the blend; CPM standalone forward base case 0.80-1.10.
  • Universe risk: 9-asset CPM universe + QQQ for BULL + PIT Nasdaq-100 for NDX. Curated via ablation/robustness iteration, not best-of-N sweep, but DSR concern remains after broad parameter exploration.
  • NDX survivorship bias + EXT fallback: PIT constituent data only goes back to 2006-01. Pre-2007 in the EXT backtest, NDX sleeve mirrors BULL-QQQ weights (so the 10% NDX weight becomes extra BULL exposure, not cash). A 2000-2010 tech-lost-decade with proper PIT NDX would likely underperform vs BULL-QQQ alone -- cannot be verified.
  • Crisis-concentrated alpha: CPM defensive sleeve delivers most of its edge in crisis years (2008, 2002, 2020, 2022). Non-crisis years lag SPY by design.
  • Lags V-shaped recoveries: 2009 full-year -10.8pp vs SPY; 2020-Q2 -27.6pp vs SPY in the snap-back. Canary slow to re-engage after deep selloffs.
  • Bullish-rally underperformance is structural: MAX_LEVERAGE=1.0 prevents vol-target from levering up in low-vol bull runs. Strategy gives up bull upside in exchange for crisis alpha as designed.
  • 2020+ regime favors NDX: mega-cap concentration regime massively rewarded top-K=4 NDX selection. Forward regime may revert.
  • Strategy not yet live-traded. Forward expectation should anchor below backtest. Bootstrap CI on Sharpe is wide.
